parent_objective: design local first-action effectiveness probe before objective or architecture changes
blocked_by: M835 response/action interventions create action drift but not outcome evidence

public_gates: M837 must define local action override directions and bounds
M837 must separate controllability evidence from policy self-ID evidence
M837 must keep PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run replay in M837
do not train actor or residual parameters
do not reinterpret direct action override success as policy self-ID
do not relax M835 thresholds after seeing the result

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a direct action override controllability probe after hidden and response/action counterfactuals are outcome-weak
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay, PPO, or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if the probe would be interpreted as policy self-ID proof
stop if action override bounds are unphysical or too large
stop if it cannot reuse M832 near-boundary pairs
stop if it would train parameters
fallback_plan: if action-effective directions exist, design an outcome-coupled objective
if no action-effective directions exist, redesign boundary states or sequence targets
if the probe is not feasible, pivot to architecture/objective design with explicit caveat
if more narrow milestones accumulate, synthesize before continuation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M836 audits M835 as action-drift metric artifact without outcome evidence

hypothesis: A local direct-action override probe can determine whether M832 near-boundary states are first-action controllable enough to support an outcome-coupled response-history objective.
success_criteria: M837 writes a design document for local action-effectiveness probing
M837 defines override directions bounds and acceptance gates
M837 states that direct override evidence is not policy self-ID proof
M837 keeps PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: M837 trains actor or residual parameters
M837 treats action override success as learned policy proof
decision_rule: M837 may only design the action-effectiveness probe. It must not run replay, train, run PPO, or promote.
